name: Frequent Subgraphs in One Labeled Graph
shortfall_explanation: Two upstream GPU MNI mining implementations are included. Their count-only interfaces and compiled size limits remain explicit; transaction-support mining is separate.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
